conventions.bump: float64 make_bump_map; global 3D np.interp from [min,max] to [1,1e6]
conventions.weight: float32 make_patch_mask; bump divided by center of 3x3x3 stride-shifted bump sum
conventions.blend: sum(prediction * weight) / sum(weight) over actual contributors; binary64 accumulation
conventions.float32Blend: float32 products and sequential sums, multiplied by float32 reciprocal of weight sum
conventions.constantFieldBoundaryPolicy: Divide by actual positive accumulated mask, not 1 or contributor count; no epsilon clamp
conventions.rawVsMask: Raw and phase-normalized blending agree on a common stride lattice before float32 rounding, but not generally for shifted tail origins
